decision: No remaining static blocker to a ROOT-guarded full diagnostic after the larger-prefix result selects and admits the exact block size. Fidelity has not launched work or approved production adoption.
remaining_limits: The resident floor of 32 GiB for context buffers plus 8 GiB scratch is necessary only. It does not prove the selected block workspace or allocator will fit.
One original full call and one call per candidate in fixed order support qualification and diagnosis, not stable throughput or a warm 20-parent cache cycle.
Separate cold layout caches in one process may retain multiple plans. The 256 GiB RSS guard and external 288 GiB family guard must include them.

Passing this run would close the direct original CPU1 to selected CPU8 numerical comparison for the chosen configuration. Deployment still needs an immutable successor, provenance, combined RAM admission, and migration from the current durable checkpoint.
This run makes no architecture-quality claim, performs no held-out scoring, and introduces no production binding.

resource_admission.precondition: Prefix measurements must establish the selected 512- or 1024-hold activation peaks and spare capacity before admitting the full candidate. The original CPU1 peak fitted the prior 64 GiB diagnostic; the new full run remains guarded.

review_scope: Complete 411-line runner reviewed through the previously read base and exact focused diff; AST parsed without source execution. Added dependencies and metadata were inspected, and the frozen production pin closure was verified.
reviewed_changes: The original arm retains 128-hold grouping and sets one CPU thread before its update, matching current production. Both selected arms set eight threads. Per-arm records and the global map state the actual counts.

Selected arms use a separate LargeBlockLayoutCache and the large_block_executors factory. The resident_context flag selects the matching resident decoder. Inherited scientific methods remain unchanged.

The source list includes all 157 frozen attempt5 dependencies, verifies expected hashes, captures the job specification itself, and rechecks the complete union before each full update and at completion. This includes libstructural.so and the preparation and layout dependencies missing from earlier narrow lists.
Original model, AdamW and RNG restoration; all original targets and history; the strict comparator; and the OOM-safe stage-peak and failure machinery remain unchanged.
